target.title: Collaboration tools use a TypeScript sub-agent controller
target.test: Collaboration tools must no longer return placeholder unavailable output; spawn_agent, send_input, wait_agent, close_agent, resume_agent, and list_agents should call a real in-process controller.

steps.instruction: Inspect collaboration tool implementations and the agent runtime wiring.
steps.expected: The tools call a shared controller through ToolContext, and AgentRuntime passes the controller into runAgent.

steps.instruction: Run a small built output script that spawns a mock child agent, waits for it, lists it, and closes it.
steps.expected: The script observes JSON outputs with real agent ids and terminal child status rather than status=unavailable.

target.passCriteria: A child agent can be spawned and waited on through the built collaboration tool path.

target.instruction: Inspect collaboration tool implementations and the agent runtime wiring.
target.expected: The tools call a shared controller through ToolContext, and AgentRuntime passes the controller into runAgent.

steps.descript: Collaboration tools dispatch to ToolContext.agentController and runtime passes a shared controller into runAgent.
evidence: packages/ndx/src/tools/collaboration/agents.ts dispatches spawn_agent, send_input, resume_agent, wait_agent, close_agent, and list_agents to context.agentController.
packages/ndx/src/tools/collaboration/agent-jobs.ts dispatches spawn_agents_on_csv and report_agent_job_result to context.agentController.
packages/ndx/src/runtime/runtime.ts creates a sub-agent controller and passes agentController into the injected runAgent call.

target.instruction: Run a small built output script that spawns a mock child agent, waits for it, lists it, and closes it.
target.expected: The script observes JSON outputs with real agent ids and terminal child status rather than status=unavailable.

steps.descript: The smoke script spawned, waited, listed, and closed a mock child agent.
evidence: Smoke output: spawnStatus=running, waitStatus=completed, finalText=mock agent completed, listedCount=1, closeStatus=closed.
The smoke script imported packages/ndx/dist/agent/subagents.js and used MockModelClient plus runAgent.

result.descript: Collaboration tools use the implemented sub-agent controller and the built path works.
evidence: No collaboration tool path returned the prior TypeScript multi-agent backend unavailable placeholder during the smoke.
The child agent reached completed status through waitAgent.
